100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On September 21, 1926, the British government announced a significant increase in coal production to combat the ongoing national strike affecting miners. Meanwhile, in the United States, the stock market continued to show signs of volatility as investors reacted to economic uncertainties. In Europe, tensions rose as the League of Nations convened to address the escalating situation in the Ruhr Valley, highlighting ongoing disputes over reparations following World War I.
